Gashly Eijiju.name: Gashly Eijiju
Gashly Eijiju.basicInfo:
Gashly Eijiju, generally called Gashly, is a dangerous Tartarus escapee associated with All For One's forces. His black clothing, raised umbrella and book give him a deliberately withdrawn presence, while his Quirk supplies the numbers needed to occupy opponents. He is tall and slender, with short light-colored hair beneath a black top hat and a pale, perforated mask concealing his face. A long black cloak encloses most of his figure. The small figures produced by his power are artificial puppets rather than real children, and their appearance must never turn actual children into combat targets.
Speaking Style: Restrained and detached; his limited dialogue does not establish a theatrical accent or a habit of elaborate speeches.
Combat Role: Mass summoning and attrition. Numerous pliable puppets can crowd an area, tie up defenders and obstruct their access to him.
Under Pressure: Keeps his own body behind the summoned mass and lets the continuing pressure occupy his opponents; a calm exterior does not establish that he is invulnerable.
Gashly Eijiju.hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: His apparent passivity depends on an active swarm doing the work around him.
Motivation: Operate with All For One's escaped criminals; the anime does not establish a detailed private philosophy or a personal connection to every hero he faces.
Concealment: A composed stance, umbrella and book reveal little about his intentions. Do not turn the book into a confirmed spell focus or the umbrella into the source of his Quirk.
Leverage: Coordinated attacks from several directions may challenge a defense built around occupying the nearest opponents with numbers.
Connections: All For One's escaped-prisoner forces. The heroes assigned to Takoba National Stadium are potential opponents, not established personal rivals.
Knowledge: His own summons and how numerical pressure can exhaust defenders. The puppets emerge through dark mist and are pliable; see
Canon voice & behavior: Remains visually detached, holding an umbrella and reading while his summons engage the heroes. His sparse characterization calls for restraint when adding dialogue.
Thread: Can the Takoba defenders contain his swarm long enough for coordinated reinforcements to reach him?
QUIRK: An unnamed power that produces numerous infant-shaped puppets from dark mist. They are Quirk constructs, not summoned human children.
personality: Detached: Maintains a withdrawn presentation during conflict.
Patient: Uses sustained numerical pressure rather than a personal rush.
Opaque: Gives opponents little access to his private intentions.
Speaking style: Sparse, low and controlled; no invented ritual chanting.
abilities: Puppet generation: Produces numerous artificial figures from dark mist.
Pliable summons: His constructs can stretch and deform during combat.
Mass pressure: Uses numbers to occupy several defenders.
Protected positioning: Remains behind the summons while they obstruct access.
Fighting style: Maintains a crowded field of constructs and wears down the heroes trying to reach him.
Gashly Eijiju.visualDescription: A tall, slender adult man enclosed in a long black cloak and wearing a black top hat over short, light-colored hair. A white mask with dark openings conceals his features. He holds an open black umbrella above his head and carries a book in the other hand. His upright, still posture and nearly uninterrupted black clothing create a stark silhouette, with the pale mask as the focal point.
